lines.text: و برگشتن هوا و تفاوت نرخها و وقوع امراض و خشکی سال سیما که زحل مستعلی باشد
lines.en: and the changing of the weather, and the difference in prices, and the occurrence of diseases, and the dryness of the year, especially if Saturn is elevated,

lines.text: و فساد نقود و تغییر عادات و رسوم خلایق و ظهور سلاطین و حکام عادل و معموری
lines.en: and the corruption of coins, and the changing of the habits and customs of the people, and the appearance of just sultans and rulers, and the prosperity

lines.text: مساجد و مدارس و قوة علما و قضاة سیما که مشتری مستعلی باشد و اکثر این تاثیرات
lines.en: of mosques and schools, and the strength of scholars and judges, especially if Jupiter is elevated, and most of these effects

lines.text: در جهة مشرق و اقلیم اول و در بعضی از اقلیم دوم باشد (اگر در حمل باشد) قوت
lines.en: will be in the direction of the east and the first clime, and in some of the second clime. (If it is in Aries) the strength

lines.text: اشراف و صدور بود و ظهور پادشاهی بزرگ با هیبت و قتل بعضی از ملوك و سلاطین
lines.en: of nobles and leaders will be, and the appearance of a great king with awe, and the killing of some kings and sultans,

lines.text: و فرماندهان و حدوث حوادث جدیده و نقصان جور و ستم و پدید آمدن دولتها و رواج
lines.en: and commanders, and the occurrence of new events, and the decrease of tyranny and oppression, and the emergence of states, and the currency

lines.text: صوامع و معابد و افکندن معابد و بناها و عمارات عالیه علی الخصوص در طرف مشرق
lines.en: of monasteries and temples, and the casting down of temples and buildings and high edifices, especially in the direction of the east,

lines.text: سیما که مشتری مستعلی و قوی حال بود و قلت زرع و جور حکام بر رعایا و کثرت حروب
lines.en: especially if Jupiter is elevated and strong in condition, and the scarcity of crops, and the tyranny of rulers over the subjects, and the abundance of wars,

lines.text: و سفك دماء و اخبار اراجیف و قوت یکی از ملوك عرب و سیما که زحل مستعلی باشد
lines.en: and the shedding of blood, and false news, and the strength of one of the kings of the Arabs, and especially if Saturn is elevated.

lines.text: (و اگر در اسد باشد) دلالت کند که پادشاه عراق و فارس را خوشحالی روی نماید و هلاك
lines.en: (And if it is in Leo) it indicates that happiness will appear for the king of Iraq and Fars, and the destruction

lines.text: بعضی از اکابر و عظما باشد و ظهور عداوت و حقد و حسد در میان مردم و صلاح نفع
lines.en: of some of the great and mighty ones will be, and the appearance of enmity and malice and envy among the people, and the goodness of benefit

lines.text: و خوشحالی مشایخ و مزارعان و مرك یکی از فقهاء و ارباب عمایم و قضاة علی الخصوص
lines.en: and happiness of sheikhs and farmers, and the death of one of the jurists and masters of turbans and judges, especially

lines.text: که مشتری بر حالت مذمومه باشد و ظهور پادشاهی از طرف مشرق و اقلیم چهارم و
lines.en: if Jupiter is in a blameworthy state, and the appearance of a king from the direction of the east and the fourth clime, and

lines.text: انتقال ملك و وضع رسوم غریبه و بسیاری تاخت و غارت و احتراق مواضع و غلبه
lines.en: the transfer of the kingdom, and the establishment of strange customs, and much raiding and plundering, and the burning of places, and the overcoming

lines.text: کردن سباع و بسیاری صید و شکار و تفاوت نرخها و ملالت بزرگان و دزدیها و
lines.en: of beasts of prey, and much hunting and trapping, and the difference in prices, and the weariness of the great ones, and thefts, and

lines.text: ظلمت هوا و خسارت اهل علم و ضیق معاش طلبه و وقوع موت در میان مردم و کثرت
lines.en: the darkness of the air, and the loss of the people of knowledge, and the straitness of livelihood of students, and the occurrence of death among the people, and the abundance

lines.text: باد و شداید و انتفاع مخاوفات و ادخنه مظلمه خاصه که زحل بر حالت مذمومه باشد
lines.en: of wind and hardships, and the benefit of fears, and dark smokes, especially if Saturn is in a blameworthy state.

lines.text: پس اگر زحل مستعلی باشد دلالت کند بر مرك ملك بابل و وقوع موت در خلایق و
lines.en: So if Saturn is elevated, it indicates the death of the king of Babylon, and the occurrence of death among the creatures, and

lines.text: آفت سباع و کمی باران و نقصان زرع در اکثر بلدان و اگر مشتری مستعلی باشد دلا
lines.en: the blight of beasts of prey, and the scarcity of rain, and the decrease of crops in most countries, and if Jupiter is elevated, it indi-

lines.text: کند بر سرور ملك بابل و موت بعضی از عظماء و هلاك کثیری از آدمیان و خوشی هوا
lines.en: cates the joy of the king of Babylon, and the death of some of the mighty ones, and the destruction of many of the humans, and the pleasantness of the weather,

lines.text: و صلاح حال زرع (و اگر در قوس باشد) دلالت کند بر فتنه و امراض و سوء حال
lines.en: and the goodness of the condition of the crops. (And if it is in Sagittarius) it indicates sedition and diseases and the bad condition

lines.text: وزراء و موت ملکی عظیم الشان و حرب میان دو پادشاه و سوختن مواضع و غا
lines.en: of viziers, and the death of a king of great dignity, and war between two kings, and the burning of places, and plun-

lines.text: نمودن و جلای مردم از مساکن و اوطان و هبوب ریاح و ظهور شخصی که دعوی
lines.en: dering, and the exile of people from their dwellings and homelands, and the blowing of winds, and the appearance of a person who claims

summary.headline: Predictions for the Fire Triplicity
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the fire triplicity, Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius, including the effects of elevated or blameworthy Saturn and Jupiter on rulers, weather, crops, disease, war, prices, and regional kingdoms. The discussion names Iraq, Fars, Babylon, and the first, second, and fourth climes.
